title: Dietary guidance
text: Vegetarian food is widely available, but Jain, vegan and allergy-safe preparation must be confirmed directly with each venue. Ask about ghee, dairy, onion, garlic and cross-contact; never assume a dish is suitable.

title: Dietary and allergy checks for Jaipur
text: In Jaipur, communicate dietary requirements directly and specifically: ingredients to avoid, acceptable cooking fat, onion/garlic rules, allergy severity and cross-contact. Ask how food is prepared and whether separate utensils are used. Carry translated allergy information when useful; never rely on a generic “vegetarian”, “Jain” or “vegan” label as a safety guarantee.

title: Jain meal requests
text: Explain the exact Jain requirements for your group: onion/garlic avoidance, root vegetables, meal timing and separate preparation may differ by practice. Confirm ingredients and cross-contact with the kitchen; “Jain available” is not a guarantee until the venue confirms.

title: Vegan food checks
text: Ask specifically about ghee, butter, milk, curd, paneer, cream, honey and dairy-based sweets; clarify cooking oil and shared utensils. Regional dishes can be adapted, but preparation varies. Confirm with the person cooking.

title: Food allergy communication
text: State the allergen clearly and explain reaction severity. Ask about ingredient labels, shared fryers, utensils, oil and kitchen cross-contact. If the venue cannot confidently answer, choose another option and follow your clinician’s emergency plan.

title: Gluten and wheat questions
text: Wheat is common in breads and some snacks. Ask about flour, shared surfaces, fryers and thickeners; millet-based dishes are not automatically free from cross-contact. Confirm the preparation rather than relying on the dish name.

title: Vegetarian ordering
text: Vegetarian options are common, but clarify whether the kitchen uses shared equipment, meat stock, gelatin or animal-derived ingredients if these matter to you. Ask about spice and dairy separately.

title: Hydration and food hygiene
text: Ask for sealed or reliably filtered water where needed, prefer freshly prepared hot food when uncertain, and consider your own health sensitivities. Food safety depends on the specific venue and current handling; no static guide can certify a kitchen.

title: Children and spice
text: Ask for mild preparation explicitly and check for whole spices, chilli, nuts and bones. Confirm portion and ingredient details with the kitchen; “not spicy” can mean different things.
